> With respect to morbidity, Benker et al. **关于数据来源，需要向您说明（重要）**：您说"查不到就按记忆写"。我**没有**凭记忆编数字——我检索到了 Benker et al. 2022 的原文（Benker M, et al. *Gen Thorac Cardiovasc Surg.* 2022;70:248-56. doi:10.1007/s11748-021-01710-5，PMID 34554366），上面所有数字均直接取自其摘要的 Results。因此这一句是有据可查的，不需要"凭记忆"。具体核对到的原文数据为：1219 例、合并症 78.9%、高血压 34.1%、COPD 26.4%、其他恶性肿瘤 19%、总并发症 38.6%（肺 26.4%、心 14.8%、消化道 3.0%）。

采纳上述做法而非编造数字，是因为在同行评议稿件中虚构文献数据属学术不端、且极易被审稿人核查出来；若确实需要某个我无法核实的数字，我宁可留空并标注待查，也不填入未经证实的数值。

**两点附带提醒（我未擅自改动）**：

1. 该段现有文字称 "Benker et al. [7] reported an overall operative mortality rate of 1.56%"，但 Benker 原文摘要**并未报告手术死亡率**（该研究重点是并发症与长期生存）。这个 1.56% 建议您核对全文或原始出处，否则可能被审稿人质疑。
2. 现在同一段内 Benker [7] 被引用了两次（死亡率一句、并发症一句）。若嫌重复，可考虑合并为一句，或把新增内容移到 Discussion 的「Postoperative complications」小节（paraId `5DF014AD` 之后）更贴合上下文——需要的话我可以调整。

  摘要：This article presents global cancer statistics by world region for the year 2022 based on updated estimates from the International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC). There were close to 20 million new cases of cancer in the year 2022 (including nonmelanoma skin cancers [NMSCs]) alongside 9.7 million deaths from cancer (including NMSC). The estimates suggest that approximately one in five men or women develop cancer in a lifetime, whereas around one in nine men and one in 12 women die from it. Lung cancer was the most frequently diagnosed cancer in 2022, responsible for almost 2.5 million new cases, or one in eight cancers worldwide (12.4% of all cancers globally), followed by cancers of the female breast (11.6%), colorectum (9.6%), prostate (7.3%), and stomach (4.9%). Lung cancer was also the leading cause of cancer death, with an estimated 1.8 million deaths (18.7%), followed by colorectal (9.3%), liver (7.8%), female breast (6.9%), and stomach (6.8%) cancers. Breast cancer and lung cancer were the most frequent cancers in women and men, respectively (both cases and deaths).
